note: EVERY HOME BASE ITS OWN PICTURE (COOK [every town looks its own], rule 186(b); EYES 10/25w line 106). towns[<the name the map posts>] is that town's picture: src by day, night_src at night, the same 2060 x 1092, its tier's hotspots to the pixel (the tier's variant 0 in settlement_ground_packs/), so every tap and every box in the screen (ARMSBOX, LOTBOX, BUILDBOX, LOOKBOX) lands where it did; settlement_walk.json beside it carries every thing drawn in each picture, measured in the scene (roof to front foot), in RUN TWO's own format. A name not in towns keeps the tier picture (the camp, a place not a home base).
tall_and_wide: ONE PLAN, TWO COMPOSITIONS (COOK [every town built for tall and wide], rule 220): towns[name].wide is the 2060 x 1092 picture (16:9 side on, a computer) and towns[name].tall the 1024 x 1820 one (9:16, a phone upright), the same buildings moved to fit; the screen shows the one that fits the shape and swaps on a turn (RUN TWO). Each carries its own hotspots (the screen's KMAP roles) AND boxes (what ARMSBOX, LOTBOX, BUILDBOX, LOOKBOX held for the tier), doors (where a keeper stands, picture px) and entrance (the street's end on the side the map's road comes in). Nothing he taps stands in the bottom three tenths at either side (rule 213, the phone's corner).
